gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: There is an apparent tension between narrative statements in the Strategic Report (which refer to reserve releases) and the Technical Provisions reconciliation (which shows various gross movements). The primary prior-year movement used here is the explicit "surpluses/(deficits) following the reassessment" table (page 40) showing a net surplus of GBP 9.649m (release) which is used as the prior_year_development. The Technical Provisions table contains a gross "Change in prior year provisions" line of GBP 87.002m (gross increase) which appears to reflect a different aggregate gross movement; per the specification the reassessment/surplus table was preferred. Some regulatory class names were copied verbatim from the underwriting analysis; one small negative/near-zero value for "Energy - non marine" appears in the scanned table as  (9) thousand which has been represented here as -0.009m. Extraction from scanned images may introduce small rounding/interpretation uncertainty.
